name: code-commandments
title: Code Commandments
description: The static code checker judges the codebase, its hooks run inside the journal, and every rule and language is a switch in its settings

php.hint: code-commandments runs on PHP 8.4 or newer

composer.hint: composer installs the checker inside the plugin's own folder

setup.name: Install the checker in the plugin's folder
Write the chosen switches into config.php
Judge the codebase as a check
setup.run: journal check create "The codebase keeps its architecture" --set command=".journal/plugins/code-commandments/bin/commandments judge" --set every=0

folders_judged.title: Folders to check
folders_judged.help: One folder per line, from the project root. Empty, config.php keeps the folders it names.

folders_skipped.title: Folders to leave out
folders_skipped.help: One folder per line, never read or reported, such as generated code. This list is what config.php leaves out.

sin_blank-string-default.title: BlankStringDefault
sin_blank-string-default.help: A declaration typed as a TOTAL `string` defaulting to the blank, whose own scope then asks that name `=== ''` / `empty(...)` — the question is the proof that the blank is absence wearing a total type.

sin_blank-string-on-the-wire.title: BlankStringOnTheWire
sin_blank-string-on-the-wire.help: A public field typed as a TOTAL `string` whose reader on the FAR SIDE asks it `=== ''`.

sin_cancelled-coalesce.title: CancelledCoalesce
sin_cancelled-coalesce.help: A manufactured fake compared against itself — `($x ?? '') !== ''`.

sin_conditional-array-spread.title: ConditionalArraySpread
sin_conditional-array-spread.help: Flags a conditional array-element spread — `...($x ? ['k' => $x] : [])` inside an array literal, or `array_merge($base, $cond ? [...] : [])` — the ternary-into-empty-array noise.

sin_de-nulled-finder.title: DeNulledFinder
sin_de-nulled-finder.help: Detects a nullable finder whose result is de-nulled at every call site (≥2 sites); absence should be decided at the source, not re-checked everywhere.

sin_erased-null-object.title: ErasedNullObject
sin_erased-null-object.help: A `new X` whose `__toString` renders `''`, written where the declared type is `string` — a default or a return.

sin_nullable-callback.title: NullableCallback
sin_nullable-callback.help: A nullable callback (`?callable $cb = null`) that the body null-normalises before calling — `if ($cb !== null) { $cb(…); }`, `($cb ?? fn () => …)(…)`.

sin_option-as-nullable.title: OptionAsNullable
sin_option-as-nullable.help: Detects `?Option`, `Option | null`, and `unwrapOr(null)` collapsing absence; exempt in argument position, flagged only in return/assignment. /

sin_flag-argument.title: FlagArgument
sin_flag-argument.help: A method whose whole body is `if ($flag) {…} else {…}` on one of its own `bool` parameters — two methods sharing a name, and a call site that reads `render($order, true)`.

sin_member-after-method.title: MemberAfterMethod
sin_member-after-method.help: Detects state declared below behaviour: a trait use, constant, property, property hook or enum case that sits after a method in the same class body.

sin_member-out-of-order.title: MemberOutOfOrder
sin_member-out-of-order.help: Detects a head of class assembled in an ad-hoc order — a constant under a property, a public field under a private one, a derived hook above the fields it reads.

sin_concurrent-subclass.title: ConcurrentSubclass
sin_concurrent-subclass.help: A class that `extends` the `jessegall/concurrent` package's `Concurrent` proxy — inheriting the thread-safe shared-state wrapper instead of composing it.

sin_namespace-cycle.title: NamespaceCycle
sin_namespace-cycle.help: Two namespaces that reference each other — `App\Billing` reaching into `App\Orders` while `App\Orders` reaches back — so the pair is one unit wearing two names.

sin_namespace-dependency.title: NamespaceDependency
sin_namespace-dependency.help: A reference OUT of a declared layer into a layer that layer may not use — the arrow pointing back up the stack, or sideways.

sin_archaeology-comment.title: ArchaeologyComment
sin_archaeology-comment.help: Detects comments describing history instead of present code.

sin_bloated-docblock.title: BloatedDocblock
sin_bloated-docblock.help: A class whose docblock runs to multiple paragraphs.

sin_ceremony-docblock.title: CeremonyDocblock
sin_ceremony-docblock.help: A docblock that only restates the typed signature — `@param Type $x` with no description on an already-typed parameter, plus maybe a bare `@return Type`.

sin_dangling-doc-reference.title: DanglingDocReference
sin_dangling-doc-reference.help: A docblock cross-reference (`…` / `{@link …}`) that points at a FIRST-PARTY class the codebase does not declare — a name that was renamed or removed, its documentation left dangling.

sin_inline-docblock.title: InlineDocblock
sin_inline-docblock.help: Detects a docblock crammed onto its delimiters — the whole thing on one line, or a block that opens or closes beside its text.

sin_negative-space-comment.title: NegativeSpaceComment
sin_negative-space-comment.help: Detects comments that defend code against strawmen — a negation paired with a word like "random", "magic", or "coincidence", where the code should simply state what it IS.

sin_restated-comment.title: RestatedComment
sin_restated-comment.help: Detects an inline comment that only narrates the statement it sits on: reduce the comment to its content words and the annotated statement's head to the words it spells (AstNode::codeWords()), and flag when EVERY comment word is already one of them — a comment carrying a why brings a word the code lacks, so it survives.

sin_stacked-docblock.title: StackedDocblock
sin_stacked-docblock.help: Detects a declaration wearing several docblocks.

sin_const-class-enum.title: ConstClassEnum
sin_const-class-enum.help: A class that is nothing but scalar constants — a closed set of values hand- rolled as `const STATUS_PENDING = 'pending'` instead of a native backed enum.

sin_enum-case-or-chain.title: EnumCaseOrChain
sin_enum-case-or-chain.help: `$x === Status::Pending || $x === Status::Paid` — a hand-rolled membership test against two-or-more cases of the same backed enum.

sin_enum-value-match.title: EnumValueMatch
sin_enum-value-match.help: Detects `match`/`switch` over a backed enum's `->value` at a call site.

sin_in-array-mirrors-enum.title: InArrayMirrorsEnum
sin_in-array-mirrors-enum.help: `in_array($x, ['a', 'b', …])` whose literals ARE an existing backed enum's case values — testing membership of a set the type already seals.

sin_match-default-returns-null.title: MatchDefaultReturnsNull
sin_match-default-returns-null.help: A `match` whose `default` arm returns `null`/`false`/`[]` instead of throwing.

sin_string-match-mirrors-enum.title: StringMatchMirrorsEnum
sin_string-match-mirrors-enum.help: Detects `match`/`switch` arm conditions that are string/int literals mirroring an existing backed enum's case values.

sin_unnamed-vocabulary-literal.title: UnnamedVocabularyLiteral
sin_unnamed-vocabulary-literal.help: A raw string filling an argument the codebase ELSEWHERE fills from a named vocabulary — a `$this->expect('{')` beside a `$this->expect(Token::COLON)`, when `Token::BRACE_OPEN` already holds it.

sin_generic-exception.title: GenericException
sin_generic-exception.help: Throwing a generic SPL/base exception (`throw new \RuntimeException(...)`) instead of a named domain exception.

sin_message-at-throw.title: MessageAtThrow
sin_message-at-throw.help: `throw new X("…message…")` — the failure described with a prose string at the throw site instead of a named factory carrying domain VALUES (`throw OrderNotFound::forId($id)`).

sin_swallow-catch.title: SwallowCatch
sin_swallow-catch.help: A `catch` that swallows the failure into absence — an empty body, or whose only effect is `return null/false/[]`.

sin_wrapping-without-cause.title: WrappingWithoutCause
sin_wrapping-without-cause.help: Throwing a new exception inside a `catch` without passing the caught one on as its cause (`previous`) — the original failure and its stack trace are dropped, so the wrapped error lies about where it came from.

sin_constructor-side-effect.title: ConstructorSideEffect
sin_constructor-side-effect.help: A constructor with a SIDE EFFECT — it calls a collaborator and throws the result away, so the call was made for what it DID: eager-loading a relation, writing a global default, narrowing a query builder the caller still holds.

sin_divergent-twin.title: DivergentTwin
sin_divergent-twin.help: Flags a method that does the same job as another and does STRICTLY LESS of it.

sin_duplicate-function.title: DuplicateFunction
sin_duplicate-function.help: Two-or-more functions/methods with an identical AST — the same code copy-pasted, down to a formatting-blind structural hash (spacing, newlines, and comments are ignored; only real code differences count).

sin_manufactured-fake-fill.title: ManufacturedFakeFill
sin_manufactured-fake-fill.help: Detects filling an argument with a manufactured fake (empty string, zero, false) on absence; real defaults like `?? 'EUR'` are legitimate.

sin_mutable-static-state.title: MutableStaticState
sin_mutable-static-state.help: A write to static state — a global with a namespace in front of it.

sin_near-duplicate-function.title: NearDuplicateFunction
sin_near-duplicate-function.help: Two-or-more functions/methods with the same SHAPE but not identical text — the same control-flow skeleton differing only in variable names or literal values (a type-2 clone).

sin_coalesced-loop-subject.title: CoalescedLoopSubject
sin_coalesced-loop-subject.help: A `foreach` that decides in its own header whether it was HANDED anything to iterate — `foreach ($below[$id] ?? [] as $child)`, `$below` being a parameter.

sin_deep-nesting.title: DeepNesting
sin_deep-nesting.help: An `if` nested three-deep — a pyramid of conditions.

sin_if-else-ladder.title: IfElseLadder
sin_if-else-ladder.help: An `if`/`elseif` ladder of four-plus branches — a chain of conditions doing the job of a `match`, a method on the type, or polymorphic dispatch.

sin_inline-throw.title: InlineThrow
sin_inline-throw.help: Detects `?? throw` buried in a call arg or dereference, not bare return statements. /

sin_loop-inverted-guard.title: LoopInvertedGuard
sin_loop-inverted-guard.help: A loop whose entire body is wrapped in one `if` — the iteration's real work pushed a level deep behind a condition.

sin_nested-ternary.title: NestedTernary
sin_nested-ternary.help: A nested / chained ternary — `$a ? $b : ($c ? $d : $e)` — folds a branching decision into one unreadable expression where the operator precedence is a trap.

sin_non-counting-for.title: NonCountingFor
sin_non-counting-for.help: A `for` that is not counting — its step ASSIGNS the next thing rather than advancing a counter, as in `for ($one = $r; $one !== null; $one = $one instanceof Traceable ? $one->getAbove() : null)`.

sin_redundant-else.title: RedundantElse
sin_redundant-else.help: An `else` after an `if` branch that already exits (`return`/`throw`/`continue`/ `break`).

sin_short-circuit-statement.title: ShortCircuitStatement
sin_short-circuit-statement.help: A short-circuit operator standing as a whole statement — `$node->isBuilt() && $node->built()->forget();`.

sin_ternary-statement.title: TernaryStatement
sin_ternary-statement.help: A ternary standing as a whole statement — `$this->holds($id) ? array_push(…) : $gone[] = $id;`.

sin_config-read.title: ConfigRead
sin_config-read.help: Reading configuration with `config(...)` inside a class instead of injecting a typed config object.

sin_container-reach.title: ContainerReach
sin_container-reach.help: Reaching into the container with `app()`/`resolve()` from a class the container resolves — the dependency belongs in the constructor.

sin_dead-config-key.title: DeadConfigKey
sin_dead-config-key.help: A key declared in `config/*.php` that nothing in the codebase names.

sin_dead-event-wiring.title: DeadEventWiring
sin_dead-event-wiring.help: An `Event::listen(X::class, …)` whose event class nothing can fire: X is never constructed and never dispatched statically.

sin_duplicated-config-default.title: DuplicatedConfigDefault
sin_duplicated-config-default.help: A read of a config key that supplies its OWN fallback while the config file already states one — `intOr('shop.realtime.port', 8086)` against `'port' => env('PORT', 8086)`.

sin_facade-call.title: FacadeCall
sin_facade-call.help: Detects Laravel facade calls that hide dependencies; inject the underlying contract instead.

sin_mass-update-at-call-site.title: MassUpdateAtCallSite
sin_mass-update-at-call-site.help: A mass `->update([...])` on an Eloquent model at a call site — an untyped array of attributes smuggling a mutation past the model's own methods.

sin_model-mutation-at-call-site.title: ModelMutationAtCallSite
sin_model-mutation-at-call-site.help: Setting an Eloquent model's properties at a call site and then `->save()`-ing it — the mutation belongs behind an intention-revealing method on the model (`$order->markPaid()`), not smeared across the caller.

sin_orphaned-binding.title: OrphanedBinding
sin_orphaned-binding.help: A `bind`/`singleton`/`scoped`/`instance` registration whose abstract nothing outside the registration ever names — no type-hint, no `app()`/`make()`, no mention at all.

sin_raw-request-input.title: RawRequestInput
sin_raw-request-input.help: An untyped read off a Laravel request — `->input(...)`, `->get(...)`, `->query(...)`, `->post(...)` on a `Request`/`FormRequest`/MCP request.

sin_request-accessor-recast.title: RequestAccessorRecast
sin_request-accessor-recast.help: A typed request accessor immediately re-flattened to a bare string — `$request->string($k)->toString()` or `(string) $request->string($k)`.

sin_bare-state-predicate.title: BareStatePredicate
sin_bare-state-predicate.help: A `bool` about the object's OWN state, named as a bare verb — `binds()` where `isBound()` belongs.

sin_narrated-command.title: NarratedCommand
sin_narrated-command.help: A command whose name narrates instead of ordering — `hides()` where `hide()` belongs.

sin_constructor-orchestration.title: ConstructorOrchestration
sin_constructor-orchestration.help: A page object imperatively filling a public slot in its constructor.

sin_injected-service-not-hidden.title: InjectedServiceNotHidden
sin_injected-service-not-hidden.help: Detects injected services in public properties without #[Hidden] on page objects; non-public properties are exempt. /

sin_manual-output-transform.title: ManualOutputTransform
sin_manual-output-transform.help: Flags a `Data` slot that hand-flattens one value object into a wire array — a getter hook, a `#[Computed]` method, or a constructor assignment — where a `#[WithTransformer]` should own the shape. /

sin_page-object-missing-typescript.title: PageObjectMissingTypeScript
sin_page-object-missing-typescript.help: Flags a page object — a `Data` that composes multiple nested `Data` AND travels back in a response — carrying no `#[TypeScript]`.

sin_service-location-in-page-object.title: ServiceLocationInPageObject
sin_service-location-in-page-object.help: Detects page objects using service location (`app()`, `resolve()`) instead of injecting via `#[FromContainer]` attributes. /

sin_transformer-without-ts-type.title: TransformerWithoutTsType
sin_transformer-without-ts-type.help: Flags a custom `#[WithTransformer]` on a `Data` property with no paired `#[TypeScriptType]` / `#[LiteralTypeScriptType]`, so the generated TS keeps the PHP type while the wire carries the transformed shape.

sin_computed-boolean-argument.title: ComputedBooleanArgument
sin_computed-boolean-argument.help: A chooser taking only bool(s) that every caller computes off the SAME object — `CornerInset::of($editor->inZenMode() || $editor->hasPanelOpen())`.

sin_converted-argument.title: ConvertedArgument
sin_converted-argument.help: Flags a parameter declared in the wrong currency: the caller holds a value, converts it into the form the callee wants, and passes the conversion — `Raises::of(ClassAlias::of($interaction), …)`.

sin_derived-argument.title: DerivedArgument
sin_derived-argument.help: Flags a call site that hands over a PROJECTION of a value rather than the value itself, where the callee could have derived it — `persist($request, $request->getShopChannelId())` wanted only `$request`.

sin_param-resolved-from-param.title: ParamResolvedFromParam
sin_param-resolved-from-param.help: Detects methods unpacking a target from a container parameter; pass the resolved object, not the container plus a key. /

sin_repeated-guard.title: RepeatedGuard
sin_repeated-guard.help: Flags a compound boolean guard (≥2 substantive conjuncts, at least one NOT a bare `instanceof` — pure-type chains are the repeated-type-guard's domain) that recurs in ≥2 places.

sin_repeated-named-call.title: RepeatedNamedCall
sin_repeated-named-call.help: Flags a `with`-style (variadic-parameter) method — `copyWith(mixed ...$changes)` — called with the SAME named argument, carrying construction boilerplate, at $threshold+ sites that resolve to the SAME method (grouped by its declaring class, so inherited calls on subclasses of one base collapse into one group and unrelated classes stay separate).

sin_repeated-type-guard.title: RepeatedTypeGuard
sin_repeated-type-guard.help: Flags a multi-`instanceof` type-narrowing guard (`$x instanceof A && $x->y instanceof B`) that recurs VERBATIM in ≥2 places — a check copied instead of named.

sin_nullable-registry-lookup.title: NullableRegistryLookup
sin_nullable-registry-lookup.help: Detects registries returning null on miss (`$this->items[$key] ?? null`) instead of throwing.

sin_boundary-duplicated-operation.title: BoundaryDuplicatedOperation
sin_boundary-duplicated-operation.help: Two entry points on DIFFERENT kinds of boundary — a console command and an MCP tool, a controller and a command — performing the same domain calls.

sin_dangling-route-name.title: DanglingRouteName
sin_dangling-route-name.help: A `route('x')` / `to_route('x')` lookup whose name no registration mints.

sin_duplicate-route.title: DuplicateRoute
sin_duplicate-route.help: Detects two-or-more routes with the same verb+action bound to different URLs.

sin_duplicate-route-action.title: DuplicateRouteAction
sin_duplicate-route-action.help: Detects duplicate thin delegations to the same service across ≥2 controllers.

sin_route-delegates-to-controller.title: RouteDelegatesToController
sin_route-delegates-to-controller.help: Detects a route action that thin-wraps another route action — a controller pass-through that creates redundant HTTP entry points.

sin_all-nullable-data.title: AllNullableData
sin_all-nullable-data.help: Detects Spatie Data classes where every field is nullable; make required fields non-nullable so `from()` fails on a real miss.

sin_all-optional-data.title: AllOptionalData
sin_all-optional-data.help: Detects a `Data` class where EVERY promoted property is `T|Optional` — the all-optional sibling of the all-nullable "god" DTO.

sin_data-collection-type.title: DataCollectionType
sin_data-collection-type.help: Flags a `Data` property typed as `DataCollection` — it must be `array` (preferred) or `Collection` with `#[DataCollectionOf(X)]`.

sin_data-method-hint-collision.title: DataMethodHintCollision
sin_data-method-hint-collision.help: A Spatie `Data` class with a `@method` docblock tag that re-declares a method the class ACTUALLY has, colliding with it (`@method static static fromCredential(...)` over a real `fromCredential()`).

sin_hook-missing-computed.title: HookMissingComputed
sin_hook-missing-computed.help: Flags a get-only property hook on a `Data` class that lacks `#[Computed]`.

sin_manual-hydration-loop.title: ManualHydrationLoop
sin_manual-hydration-loop.help: `<Data>::from(...)` called per item of a collection — inside a `foreach`/`for`/ `while` loop, or as an `array_map` callback.

sin_manual-input-cast.title: ManualInputCast
sin_manual-input-cast.help: Flags a `Data` value-object property that is hand-built at EVERY `::from()` site (via the whole-program DataConstructions index), where a `#[WithCast]` / `Castable` should own the mapping once. /

sin_nested-type-missing-typescript.title: NestedTypeMissingTypeScript
sin_nested-type-missing-typescript.help: Flags a property on a `#[TypeScript]` Data whose nested Data/backed-enum type itself lacks `#[TypeScript]` — the transformer emits it as `undefined`, a silent hole in the generated frontend contract.

sin_new-data-object.title: NewDataObject
sin_new-data-object.help: Detects `new Data(...)` instead of `::from(...)` — skips casts, name maps, nested hydration, and factories.

sin_non-final-data.title: NonFinalData
sin_non-final-data.help: Detects non-final Spatie Data classes (DTOs are values, not bases).

sin_null-to-optional-map.title: NullToOptionalMap
sin_null-to-optional-map.help: Flags a hand-rolled null→`Optional` map — an "absent" Optional (`new Optional` OR the preferred `Optional::create()`) sitting as a ternary fallback (`$x === null ? Optional::create() : Foo::from($x)`) or the right of a `??` (`expr() ?? Optional::create()`).

sin_nullable-wire-object.title: NullableWireObject
sin_nullable-wire-object.help: Flags a nullable nested-object field (`T | null`, T a `Data` subclass or enum) on a `#[TypeScript]` Data class, where `T | Optional` belongs: on the wire `?T = null` ships `"field": null`, whereas `Optional` omits it — what the frontend's optional-chaining reads for "absent".

sin_prefer-optional-create.title: PreferOptionalCreate
sin_prefer-optional-create.help: Flags a raw `new Optional` in a runtime expression and prefers Spatie's built-in `Optional::create()` factory.

sin_data-to-array-roundtrip.title: DataToArrayRoundtrip
sin_data-to-array-roundtrip.help: Flags `X::from(...)->toArray()` whose array result sits in a `::from` slot typed `X` (a nested `Data` or a `#[DataCollectionOf(X)]` element) that re-hydrates it — a build → array → build round-trip.

sin_derived-collection-cast.title: DerivedCollectionCast
sin_derived-collection-cast.help: Flags `array_map(E::for(...), $xs)` filling a `#[DataCollectionOf(E)]` slot — a per-item DERIVATION the call site does by hand, where a `#[WithCast]`/`IterableItemCast` on the property should own it.

sin_hand-key-remap.title: HandKeyRemap
sin_hand-key-remap.help: Flags `SomeData::from(['camelKey' => $src['snake_key'], …])` — a hand-written snake→camel key translation off one source array that a class-level `#[MapInputName(SnakeCaseMapper::class)]` + `::from($src)` owns once.

sin_redundant-enum-unwrap.title: RedundantEnumUnwrap
sin_redundant-enum-unwrap.help: Flags an enum destructured to `->value` inside a `Data::from([...])` slot whose property is typed as that same enum (`'status' => $order->status->value`).

sin_redundant-native-cast.title: RedundantNativeCast
sin_redundant-native-cast.help: Flags `Enum::from($x)` / `new DateTime($x)` / `Carbon::parse($x)` sitting in a `Data::from([...])` slot typed as that enum or a `DateTimeInterface` — the value Spatie auto-casts from the raw scalar, so the construction is ceremony.

sin_redundant-nested-from.title: RedundantNestedFrom
sin_redundant-nested-from.help: Flags `X::from([array literal])` sitting in a parent `SomeData::from([...])` where the destination slot — a nested `Data` property or a `#[DataCollectionOf(X)]` element — auto-hydrates the array itself, so the wrapper is ceremony.

sin_feature-envy.title: FeatureEnvy
sin_feature-envy.help: Exiled behaviour (feature envy) — a method that reaches THROUGH one other owned object's structure, iterating its collection, to do work that belongs ON that object (`$node->edges()`, not `EdgeDetector::detect($node)`).

sin_keyed-lookup-envy.title: KeyedLookupEnvy
sin_keyed-lookup-envy.help: Feature envy through an indirect lookup — a method that uses an owned object's identity as a KEY to fetch data about it through a collaborator, then reads a fact back (`$this->registry->get($node->key)->reservedOutputNames`).

sin_type-switch.title: TypeSwitch
sin_type-switch.help: A run of `instanceof` tests on the same subject, each deciding a different branch — the caller asking a value what it IS so it can decide what to do, when the value could simply be told.

sin_assembled-template.title: AssembledTemplate
sin_assembled-template.help: Detects a fixed multi-line template built as an array of line fragments and joined with a newline.

sin_masked-invariant.title: MaskedInvariant
sin_masked-invariant.help: `$this->scratch?->call() ?? false` — defaulting a reach into the object's own TRANSIENT nullable state.

sin_phantom-nullable.title: PhantomNullable
sin_phantom-nullable.help: A field typed `?T` whose value is always consumed as present (never guarded) per the ValueFlow provenance graph.

sin_placeholder-filled-data.title: PlaceholderFilledData
sin_placeholder-filled-data.help: A Data construction handing `''` to a slot typed as a required, non-nullable `string` — the envelope's TYPES stay honest while its VALUES are manufactured.

sin_redundant-arrow-return-type.title: RedundantArrowReturnType
sin_redundant-arrow-return-type.help: An arrow function carrying a return type its own expression already proves — `fn (): string => $this->name` where `$name` IS a `string`.

sin_scratch-state-restore.title: ScratchStateRestore
sin_scratch-state-restore.help: A method that SAVES one of its own properties to a local and RESTORES it afterwards — `$prev = $this->scope; … $this->scope = $prev;`.

sin_useless-property-hook.title: UselessPropertyHook
sin_useless-property-hook.help: A `get` hook whose body references no `$this` (and no `parent::`) — it computes nothing from the object, so the property is stored, not derived; the hook syntax is a lie usually copied from an interface's `{ get; }` (which a plain property satisfies).

sin_array-bag.title: ArrayBag
sin_array-bag.help: An `array` read by string-literal keys — a structured bag that should be a typed value object.

sin_array-return-bag.title: ArrayReturnBag
sin_array-return-bag.help: Detects multi-field string-keyed array returns (bags for value objects).

sin_coupled-fields.title: CoupledFields
sin_coupled-fields.help: A class's own VALUE fields that are really ONE object.

sin_data-clump.title: DataClump
sin_data-clump.help: The same three-or-more value parameters (`string $shopId, string $userId, string $channelId`) threaded through two-or-more signatures in different classes.

sin_flat-field-cluster.title: FlatFieldCluster
sin_flat-field-cluster.help: Flags a `#[TypeScript]` `Data` that spreads a value object flat across sibling scalar fields sharing a camelCase prefix — `wireType`/`wireLabel` that should be `wire: Wire{type, label}` — WHEN a small value object named for that prefix, whose fields ARE the flat remainders, already exists.

sin_hand-rolled-wither.title: HandRolledWither
sin_hand-rolled-wither.help: A wither that rebuilds its object by re-spelling the WHOLE constructor field list (`return new self($this->a, $this->b, $changed, $this->d);`) instead of saying only what changes.

sin_mutable-value-object.title: MutableValueObject
sin_mutable-value-object.help: A VALUE that can change after it is built.

sin_positional-tuple-return.title: PositionalTupleReturn
sin_positional-tuple-return.help: Detects positional tuples — keyless arrays without types or names that callers must destructure by position.

sin_raw-decoded-array-return.title: RawDecodedArrayReturn
sin_raw-decoded-array-return.help: Detects raw `json_decode(...)` arrays returned from boundaries.

sin_mirrored-server-type.title: MirroredServerType
sin_mirrored-server-type.help: Detects hand-written TypeScript types mirroring backend Spatie Data classes; the server should own the type and the frontend generate from it. /

sin_compound-inline-component.title: CompoundInlineComponent
sin_compound-inline-component.help: Detects compound UI primitives assembled inline (component root with ≥2 descendants sharing a prefix tag).

sin_deep-data-reach.title: DeepDataReach
sin_deep-data-reach.help: Detects clusters of deep data reaches (e.g., `order.customer.name`, `order.customer.email`) sharing one nested object.

sin_deep-nested.title: DeepNested
sin_deep-nested.help: A template nested far too deep; identifies the natural extraction boundary by climbing from the deep element up the single-child wrapper stack for a coherent unit. /

sin_duplicate-element.title: DuplicateElement
sin_duplicate-element.help: Detects identical template blocks (structural comparison, blind to formatting); only substantial blocks and the largest duplicate are flagged.

sin_prop-drilling.title: PropDrilling
sin_prop-drilling.help: Detects a prop threaded through ≥2 components unused.

sin_prop-mutation.title: PropMutation
sin_prop-mutation.help: Detects component writing its own props (v-model or assignment); only bare prop writes are flagged, not shadowed locals. /

sin_control-flow-on-element.title: ControlFlowOnElement
sin_control-flow-on-element.help: Detects structural directives (`v-if`/`v-else-if`/`v-else`/`v-for`) on real elements instead of `<template>` wrappers — mixes structure (what renders) with content.

sin_index-as-key.title: IndexAsKey
sin_index-as-key.help: Detects `v-for` keyed by numeric index (`:key="index"`), which shifts when items insert/reorder, breaking Vue patching and state.

sin_loop-with-condition.title: LoopWithCondition
sin_loop-with-condition.help: Detects `v-for` and `v-if`/`v-else-if` on the same element (Vue prioritizes if over for, causing correctness/performance issues).

sin_switch-case.title: SwitchCase
sin_switch-case.help: Detects `v-if`/`v-else-if` chains testing the same value against different cases (switch as conditionals).

sin_defended-certain-field.title: DefendedCertainField
sin_defended-certain-field.help: An `?.` on one of the enclosing class's OWN fields, where that field is declared total — a guard against a case the type rules out.

sin_falsely-optional-field.title: FalselyOptionalField
sin_falsely-optional-field.help: A field declared optional that is INITIALISED where it is declared.
